title: Silas and the Language
author: Ines Brightwater
blurb: Kestrel Dravenmoor, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
